# Hiving Food

Hiving Food is the first French influence agency 100% dedicated to food. Exclusive food creators, 3 professional kitchen studios in Clichy (Greater Paris), full in house production from brief to publication.

Site: https://www.hivingfood.fr
Contact: contact@hivingfood.fr
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hivingfood/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@hivingfood
Address: 4 rue Mozart, 92110 Clichy, France

## Studios (2 sets, 4 rue Mozart, 92110 Clichy, day rental)
· Studio Pro : 80 m², professional inox kitchen, 850 € HT (excl. VAT) per day
· Studio Famille : 65 m², warm home style kitchen, 1 000 € HT (excl. VAT) per day
Booking: contact@hivingfood.fr · also see https://hivingstudio.fr

## Campaigns
Every campaign is priced on brief: number of creators, formats, duration and usage rights. Contact us for a precise quote.
